statement: Pi combines a live typed AgentEvent stream with an append-only JSONL session tree whose entries carry id and parentId, allowing the active context to move between branches without deleting prior history.

display_text.zh-CN: Pi 将实时类型化 AgentEvent stream 与 append-only JSONL session tree 结合；entry 带有 id 与 parentId，使活动上下文可以在分支间移动而不删除旧历史。
display_text.en: Pi combines a live typed AgentEvent stream with an append-only JSONL session tree whose entries carry id and parentId, allowing the active context to move between branches without deleting prior history.

notes: The native JSONL format has not yet been converted into this project's normalized Trace schema.
